title: This Scientific Method Secret Changes Everything
hook: Why does nobody explain The Scientific Method like this?
script: The Scientific Method actually demands you *try* to prove your own ideas wrong. It’s not about confirming beliefs, but tirelessly seeking counter-evidence. This relentless self-correction drives all major breakthroughs, always demanding you *try* to prove your own ideas wrong.
comment: What's a 'common sense' idea that science has actually disproven?
description: Discover the surprising core principle of the Scientific Method. It's not about proving yourself right, but rigorously challenging your own ideas. This constant self-correction is how we make amazing breakthroughs! #ScientificMethod #AmazingFacts #ScienceExplained
